;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Cattle raiding]]
**[[Cattle]] thieves are reported to have killed 23 people in [[Zamfara]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-44347951 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**A migrant boat capsizes near the [[Kerkennah Islands]] off the coast of [[Tunisia]], killing at least 35 people, while 67 others are rescued by the Tunisian coast guard. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-44347955 (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-tunisia/at-least-35-migrants-dead-after-boat-sinks-off-tunisian-coast-idUSKCN1IZ0F7 (Reuters)]
**A speedboat carrying 15 migrants sinks off the coast of [[Demre]], [[Turkey]]. Nine people are killed and one person is reported missing. [http://ewn.co.za/2018/06/03/nine-dead-after-refugee-boat-sinks-off-turkey-anadolu-agency (Anadolu via Eyewitness News)]
*[[2018 Volcán de Fuego eruption]]
**[[Volcán de Fuego]] in [[Guatemala]] erupts, leaving at least 62 people dead, 300 others injured, and forces the closure of [[La Aurora International Airport]] in [[Guatemala City]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jun/04/guatemala-fuego-volcano-erupts-dead-missing (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/volcan-de-fuego-volcano-of-fire-deadly-explosions-ash-molten-rock-guatemala-city-today-2018-06-03/ (CBS News)]
*Wildfires in the [[United States|American]] states of [[California]], [[Colorado]] and [[New Mexico]] now burn {{convert|31,000|acres}} of land, causing thousands to evacuate their homes. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/03/us/west-coast-wildfires/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of North Korea]], [[Foreign relations of Syria]]
**[[North Korea]]n state news agency [[Korean Central News Agency|KCNA]] reports that [[Syria]]n [[President of Syria|President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] said last Wednesday that he will visit [[Kim Jong-un]] in North Korea. The Syrian president's office refuses to comment on the report when contacted by [[Agence France-Presse|AFP]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/03/asia/assad-visit-kim-jong-un-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/syrias-assad-to-become-first-head-of-state-to-meet-kim-in-north-korea-kcna/articleshow/64439025.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*[[India and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[India]] announces it successfully tested an [[Agni-V]] [[Intercontinental ballistic missile|ICBM]] missile at a base near [[Odisha]] coast. [https://defenceaviationpost.com/agni-v-success-boosts-indias-nuclear-deterrence/ (Defence Aviation Post)]

;Law and crime
*[[Nigeria prison break]], [[List of prison breaks in Nigeria]]
**About 200 prisoners escape in a jailbreak at the [[Minna]] Medium Security Prison. One prison officer was killed and seven prisoners rearrested. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/270962-jailbreak-200-inmates-escape-from-nigerian-prison.html (''Premium Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Slovenian parliamentary election, 2018]]
**[[Radiotelevizija Slovenija|TV Slovenia]] exit polls show that [[Janez Janša]]'s anti-immigration [[Slovenian Democratic Party]] (SDS) would win a plurality of 24.4% of the votes. [[List of Marjan Šarec]] (LMS), the party of the mayor of [[Municipality of Kamnik|Kamnik]], would follow with 12.6%. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-slovenia-election-exitpolls/anti-immigrant-sds-party-set-win-slovenia-election-exit-polls-idUSKCN1IZ0QU (Reuters)]
